titleEn: Maximum White Tiles Covered by a Carpet
title: 毯子覆盖的最多白色砖块数
summary: 不重叠白砖区间上铺一条固定长度毯子，求最多覆盖白砖数。
insight: 排序区间后让毯子左端对齐每个区间起点。双指针维护完全落入毯子的区间总长度，下一段若部分相交再加可覆盖前缀。
pitfalls: 区间端点包含在长度中
最后一个相交区间可能只覆盖一部分
移出左区间时从完整和中扣除

solutions.title: 排序区间滑窗
solutions.idea: 枚举毯子起点并维护完整覆盖区间。
steps: 对每个 left，end=tiles[left].start+carpetLen-1；把 end>=tiles[right].end 的区间加入 full
covered=full+下一未完整区间与毯子的交长度，更新答案；从 full 扣 left 区间后继续

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumWhiteTiles(int[][] tiles,int carpetLen){Arrays.sort(tiles,Comparator.comparingInt(a->a[0]));int right=0,full=0,answer=0;for(int left=0;left<tiles.length;left++){int end=tiles[left][0]+carpetLen-1;while(right<tiles.length&&tiles[right][1]<=end){full+=tiles[right][1]-tiles[right][0]+1;right++;}int covered=full;if(right<tiles.length&&tiles[right][0]<=end)covered+=end-tiles[right][0]+1;answer=Math.max(answer,covered);if(right>left)full-=tiles[left][1]-tiles[left][0]+1;else right=left+1;}return Math.min(answer,carpetLen);} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumWhiteTiles(tiles:Array<IntArray>,carpetLen:Int):Int{tiles.sortBy{it[0]};var right=0;var full=0;var answer=0;for(left in tiles.indices){val end=tiles[left][0]+carpetLen-1;while(right<tiles.size&&tiles[right][1]<=end){full+=tiles[right][1]-tiles[right][0]+1;right++};var covered=full;if(right<tiles.size&&tiles[right][0]<=end)covered+=end-tiles[right][0]+1;answer=maxOf(answer,covered);if(right>left)full-=tiles[left][1]-tiles[left][0]+1 else right=left+1};return minOf(answer,carpetLen)} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maximumWhiteTiles(vector<vector<int>>& tiles,int carpetLen){sort(tiles.begin(),tiles.end());int right=0,full=0,answer=0;for(int left=0;left<(int)tiles.size();++left){int end=tiles[left][0]+carpetLen-1;while(right<(int)tiles.size()&&tiles[right][1]<=end){full+=tiles[right][1]-tiles[right][0]+1;++right;}int covered=full;if(right<(int)tiles.size()&&tiles[right][0]<=end)covered+=end-tiles[right][0]+1;answer=max(answer,covered);if(right>left)full-=tiles[left][1]-tiles[left][0]+1;else right=left+1;}return min(answer,carpetLen);} };
